snippet.title: Theropods - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Theropods is a point and click adventure game that combines puzzles with a cinematic story, colorful characters and a retro aesthetic. Oh, and lots of dinosaurs! Travel back to the time when dinosaurs ruled the world and (a little less further back) when adventure games ruled the gaming world! Immerse yourself in a vast, prehistoric world full of dinosaurs, constructed with love, PIXEL BY PIXEL.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091870/Theropods/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
